title: The Butterfly Garden Experiment
summary: Maya discovers that planting milkweed transforms her backyard into a thriving habitat for monarch butterflies, teaching her about the critical role of native plants in nature.

pages.text: Maya loved science. She studied how things worked and grew.
pages.scene: Maya sitting at a desk with books about nature, sunlight streaming through a window, a curious expression on her face.

pages.text: One spring morning, she noticed something sad. The backyard was empty.
pages.scene: An empty backyard with grass but no flowers, butterflies, or insects visible; Maya looking disappointed from the porch.

pages.text: "Where are the butterflies?" Maya wondered. She made a plan.
pages.scene: Maya holding a notebook and pencil, drawing sketches of plants and butterflies with determined concentration.

pages.text: Maya learned that monarch butterflies need milkweed plants. She decided to plant them.
pages.scene: Maya reading a gardening book with illustrations of milkweed plants and monarch butterflies, surrounded by reference materials.

pages.text: She visited the plant nursery. The manager helped her choose seedlings.
pages.scene: A sunny nursery with rows of plants; Maya and an adult examining small milkweed plants in containers.

pages.text: Maya prepared the garden. She turned the soil and added compost.
pages.scene: Maya wearing gloves, digging in the soil with a shovel, bags of compost nearby, preparing the ground.

pages.text: She planted five milkweed seedlings in a circle. Each plant had a label.
pages.scene: Maya placing small plants in the dark soil, marking each with a wooden label showing the date and plant name.

pages.text: Every morning, Maya watered the plants. She kept notes about their growth.
pages.scene: Maya with a watering can, tending to the growing plants; a notebook showing measurements and sketches of plant development.

pages.text: Within weeks, the milkweed grew taller. Green leaves unfolded.
pages.scene: The milkweed plants growing fuller and taller, with healthy green leaves reaching toward the sun.

pages.text: Then came the flowers. Pink and yellow blooms opened.
pages.scene: Milkweed plants with pretty clusters of small pink and yellow flowers attracting early insects.

pages.text: One morning, Maya saw something wonderful. A butterfly was drinking from the flowers!
pages.scene: A beautiful monarch butterfly with orange and black wings delicately drinking nectar from a milkweed flower.

pages.text: More butterflies came. They flew from flower to flower.
pages.scene: Several monarch butterflies in various stages of resting and feeding, creating a vibrant scene in the garden.

pages.text: Maya noticed something amazing. Tiny green eggs appeared on the leaves.
pages.scene: A close-up view of milkweed leaves with small green eggs laid on the undersides, visible with careful observation.

pages.text: She checked every day. The eggs became caterpillars with yellow and black stripes.
pages.scene: Tiny striped caterpillars munching on milkweed leaves, showing the transformation from egg stage.

pages.text: The caterpillars grew bigger. They ate and ate.
pages.scene: Larger caterpillars with bold yellow and black bands feeding enthusiastically on milkweed foliage.

pages.text: Then each caterpillar made a chrysalis. They hung from the plant like jewels.
pages.scene: Green chrysalises hanging from milkweed stems, looking like tiny gems catching the light.

pages.text: Maya waited patiently. She kept her science journal complete.
pages.scene: Maya writing detailed observations in a journal, with sketches and notes about each stage of the butterfly life cycle.

pages.text: One summer day, the chrysalis cracked. A wet butterfly emerged!
pages.scene: A newly emerged monarch butterfly with wet wings just opening, clinging to the empty chrysalis.

pages.text: The butterfly dried its wings and flew away. Maya felt proud.
pages.scene: A fully-formed monarch butterfly taking flight from the milkweed plant, wings spread majestically; Maya watching with joy.

pages.text: By autumn, the garden was alive. Over fifty butterflies visited the milkweed.
pages.scene: A thriving garden bursting with multiple monarch butterflies visiting flowers, with cattails and other native plants visible too.
